snippet.title: Where Giants Fall – Official Gameplay Trailer | Free Steam Demo
snippet.description:
Play the free demo on Steam from 1 December, and wishlist the game: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4432710/Where_Giants_Fall/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=demo-dec&utm_content=trailer

Survive the swarms. Bring down the giants.

Where Giants Fall is a 3D fantasy bullet-heaven roguelite where you fight your way from desperate survival to overwhelming power. Dash through gaps in the horde and launch into a steerable aerial rush, combine weapons and active abilities into devastating builds, unleash each weapon's ultimate when it matters, and enhance your weapons at the Giantforge between stages.

The free demo is one full run of five stages: sabotage the ritual before the Iron Tyrant awakens, dodge Morvessa's spreading poison and find the gaps in Thordir's walls of fire. From 3 to 10 December the demo is part of the Bullet Heaven Festival.

Full game: March 2027 · Windows PC, Mac, plays on Steam Deck · Single-player, full controller support · 9 languages

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4432710/Where_Giants_Fall/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=demo-dec&utm_content=trailer
Discord: https://discord.gg/yb2tHNAJZC
Website: https://evercleargames.com/wheregiantsfall/
Press kit: https://evercleargames.com/wheregiantsfall/press/
